teaser.en: Its flowers open yellow like a hibiscus in the morning and fade to purple by evening.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huchanua asubuhi yakiwa ya manjano kama ya haibiskasi, na kufikia jioni hufifia kuwa ya zambarau.

summary.en: The portia tree is a small evergreen tree of beach tops and mangrove edges, with heart-shaped leaves and yellow hibiscus flowers that turn purple. It gives timber, fibre and shade.
summary.sw: Mtakawa ni mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani wa sehemu za juu za ufuo na kingo za mikoko, wenye majani yenye umbo la moyo na maua ya manjano kama ya haibiskasi yanayogeuka zambarau. Hutoa mbao, nyuzi na kivuli.

about.en:
The portia tree is a small evergreen tree with a dense crown of glossy, heart-shaped leaves on long stalks. Its flowers look like those of a hibiscus, to which it is related: cup-shaped, pale yellow with a dark red centre. Each flower lasts about a day, turning from yellow to pink and purple as it ages.

The fruit is a round, flattened capsule that dries brown and stays on the tree for a long time.
about.sw:
Mtakawa ni mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani wenye kilele kilichosongamana cha majani yanayong'aa yenye umbo la moyo na vikonyo virefu. Maua yake yanafanana na ya haibiskasi, ambayo ni ndugu yake: yana umbo la kikombe, ni ya manjano hafifu yenye kitovu chekundu kilichokolea. Kila ua hudumu takriban siku moja, likigeuka kutoka manjano hadi waridi na zambarau linapozeeka.

Tunda ni kibuyu cha mviringo kilichobapa ambacho hukauka na kuwa cha kahawia na hubaki juu ya mti kwa muda mrefu.

where.en: It grows on beach tops and on the edges of mangroves, where it can tolerate salt spray and occasional flooding. Look for its heart-shaped leaves and yellow flowers at the back of the beach or where the mangroves meet dry land.
where.sw: Huota juu ya fukwe na kwenye kingo za mikoko, ambapo unaweza kustahimili manyunyu ya chumvi na mafuriko ya mara moja moja. Utayaona majani yake yenye umbo la moyo na maua ya manjano nyuma ya ufuo au pale mikoko inapokutana na nchi kavu.

uses.en: The tree gives timber, fibre and shade.
uses.sw: Mti huu hutoa mbao, nyuzi na kivuli.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mtakawa*. In English it is the portia tree or Indian tulip tree, and its scientific name is *Thespesia populnea*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtakawa*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *portia tree* au *Indian tulip tree*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Thespesia populnea*.

reason.en: Another shade tree of the seashore
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa kivuli wa ufukweni
Hushiriki sehemu za juu za ufuo

reason.en: Same mallow family as okra and hibiscus
reason.sw: Familia moja na bamia na haibiskasi (Malvaceae)
